result.summary: Produced repair-a2.patch: (1) navigation.gd — route_clearance_into() now sets _last_refusal = REFUSE_NONE on its successful/READY branch, fixing the observed focus-a1 diagnostic leak where a prior failed read's REQUEST_NOT_READY survived a subsequent success; no other behavior, gate order, or production surface changed. (2) test_movement_clearance.gd only — added a typed, documented-order Array[int] `_snapshot()` helper built entirely from existing public Movement/Navigation getters (no private state, no new production accessor); used it plus Transforms.state_bytes() to broaden preservation checks (not phase alone) in the production per-species refusal test, both idle-mismatch tests, and the existing active-mismatch re-admission test (added speed_of and byte-exact Transform snapshots to its existing checks, keeping its verified before/after advancement); admission and contact are now constructed before each snapshot to isolate the operation under test. The getter suite now asserts out.ok/out.value/out.error explicitly on every non-ready refusal path (pending, cancelled, stale-after-service) in addition to the existing invalid/free-row checks, confirms a successful read clears both out.error and Navigation.last_refusal() after a prior failure, and confirms request identity is unchanged across reads, alongside the already-present generation/refcount checks. Added four new tests: invalid-profile-id priority over a mismatched route, unbound-contact priority over a mismatched route, clearance priority over a wrong route START (the existing test only covered wrong END), and confirmation that the synthetic fixture's profile_clearance_class_into() retains the parent's exact refusal for an invalid profile id. Every prior test method and assertion in test_movement_clearance.gd is preserved unmodified except where this request specifically asked for broadened preservation checks; no test overrides begin_travel or any admission gate, and no production file other than navigation.gd was touched.

 func route_clearance_into(row: int, out: IntMath.IntResult) -> bool:
 	"""GROUND-CLEARANCE-R01v1: the clearance class a ready request's route was searched under.
 
 	Refuses REFUSE_NOT_READY for any row that is not READY (invalid/free/pending/cancelled/
 	stale), exactly as `route_length_into()` does. Read only: no phase, route reference, queue,
 	descriptor, cache-use or packed state changes as a result of calling this.
+
+	A successful read clears the diagnostic: a prior failed read's REQUEST_NOT_READY must not
+	linger behind a subsequent success. Repair a2 -- focus-a1 observed this omission directly.
 	"""
 	if not is_ready(row):
 		_last_refusal = REFUSE_NOT_READY
 		return out.refuse(REFUSE_NOT_READY)
+	_last_refusal = REFUSE_NONE
 	return out.succeed(_d_clearance[_r_route_id[row]])

+func _snapshot(mover: MovementScript, resident: Vector2i, route: int) -> Array[int]:
+	"""One flat, EXPLICITLY ORDERED preservation witness, public getters only, no private state.
+
+	Index order: 0 phase, 1 cursor index, 2 remainder_x, 3 remainder_z, 4 owner id, 5 admitted
+	profile, 6 admitted profile revision, 7 admitted mode, 8 admitted load, 9 admitted
+	destination revision, 10 travelling count, 11 speed_of, 12 authoritative X, 13 route id,
+	14 route generation, 15 route refcount. Every value comes from an existing public reader;
+	nothing here is a new production accessor.
+	"""
+	var route_id: int = _navigation.request_route_id(route)
+	return [
+		mover.motion_phase(resident), mover.route_index_of(resident),
+		mover.remainder_x_of(resident), mover.remainder_z_of(resident),
+		mover.route_owner_id_of(resident), mover.admitted_profile_of(resident),
+		mover.admitted_profile_revision_of(resident), mover.admitted_mode_of(resident),
+		mover.admitted_load_g_of(resident), mover.admitted_destination_revision_of(resident),
+		mover.travelling_count(), mover.speed_of(resident), _x_of(resident),
+		route_id, _navigation.route_generation_of(route_id), _navigation.route_reference_count(route_id),
+	]

+func test_invalid_profile_id_refuses_before_clearance_is_considered() -> void:
+	"""An invalid profile id is caught by the existing profile-identity gate, before clearance."""
+	var start: int = _cell(ANCHOR_X, ANCHOR_Z)
+	var goal: int = _cell(ANCHOR_X + 10, ANCHOR_Z)
+	var mouse: Vector2i = _spawn_at(&"mouse", start)
+	var request: int = _route_between(start, goal, CLASS_TWO)
+	var admission: MovementScript.Admission = MovementScript.Admission.new()
+	admission.set_terms(-1, MovementScript.LIFE_STAGE_ADULT, MovementScript.MODE_GROUND_WALK, 0)
+	assert_false(
+		_movement.begin_travel(mouse, request, admission, _contact_at(goal, DESTINATION_REVISION)),
+		"an invalid profile id refuses")
+	assert_equal(
+		_movement.last_refusal(), MovementScript.REFUSE_PROFILE_ID,
+		"not the clearance mismatch, even though the route is also the wrong class")
+
+
+func test_unbound_contact_refuses_before_clearance_is_considered() -> void:
+	"""An unbound contact is caught by the existing contact gate, before clearance."""
+	var start: int = _cell(ANCHOR_X, ANCHOR_Z)
+	var goal: int = _cell(ANCHOR_X + 10, ANCHOR_Z)
+	var mouse: Vector2i = _spawn_at(&"mouse", start)

+			SpatialWorldScript.Contact.new()),

+	assert_equal(
+		_movement.last_refusal(), MovementScript.REFUSE_CONTACT_UNBOUND,
+		"not the clearance mismatch, even though the route is also the wrong class")
